export.method: ExportManager.createSTEPExportOptions on the accepted root component; native STEP translator

verification.method: Full root including hidden geometry reimported into a separate Fusion document. One-to-one body geometry and occurrence placements checked with VeryHighCalculationAccuracy physical properties.

scope: Full assembly geometry, including hidden reference, layout and test components. Native component occurrence placements retained. STEP import can renumber occurrence suffixes and assign generic body names; parametric history and Fusion joints are not part of this neutral geometry export.
preserved: Geometry and placements verified against saved MAIN cloud28. STEP omits native parametric history and joints.
